test_title: PYST 17: SSC CGL 2024 - English (Held On: 17 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains an error.

The principal gave up / the prizes to / the winners on / Republic Day.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase "**gave up**" is incorrect in this context. "Gave up" means to quit or surrender, which does not fit the intended meaning of distributing prizes.
 
• The correct verb phrase should be "**gave away**" as it means to distribute something for free, which aligns with the meaning of awarding prizes.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 1** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The principal **gave away** the prizes to the winners on Republic Day."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: "the winners on"** – This part is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 3: "the prizes to"** – This phrase correctly follows the structure of the sentence.
 
• **Option 4: "Republic Day"** – This part correctly specifies the occasion and is grammatically sound.
